title: GUARD (fixed in 7b6203cd17) — was: the `_next_tags` widget (^Xn) fails on the cycle that wraps: `_main_complete:218: command not found: _next_tags_completer`

retired.fix_commit_subject: fix(compsys): port `_next_tags_completer` / `_next_tags_pre`, scope the label filter to the widget
retired.why: Completion/Base/Widget/_next_tags is one autoload file that defines `_next_tags`, the wrap-around completer `_next_tags_completer` (sh:115-120) and the pre-completion hook `_next_tags_pre` (sh:124-139), then calls `_next_tags "$@"`. The Rust port of `_next_tags` hands `_main_complete _complete _next_tags_completer` (sh:101) and queues `compprefuncs+=( _next_tags_pre )` (sh:110), but neither helper existed, so once `_complete` ran out of tag sets `_main_complete` executed a missing command. The fix ports both helpers and registers them in the router; it also gates the ports' `$_next_tags_not` filter on the window in which the widget's redefined `_all_labels`/`_next_label` bodies are live (set at sh:10, cleared by `_next_tags_pre`'s `unfunction`+`autoload -Uz` at sh:134-135) — before, a leftover `$_next_tags_not` also hid tags from later plain TAB completions.
evidence: FAIL on the pre-fix binary (3 row(s) differ, one-sided `command not found: _next_tags_completer`)

observed.measured: 2026-10-28, a copy of target/debug/zshrs built from the shared tree carrying the fix (zshrs 0.13.56, 133994840 bytes, sha256_16 201b5f494fe2001a) vs zsh 5.9.2 (aarch64-apple-darwin25.4.0)
observed.notes: both shells: first ^Xn shows `-- first --` / `a1  a2` after TAB showed the same group, the second ^Xn wraps through `_next_tags_completer` back to it. Each lone \x18 key is reported as `no output at all` (10s) on both shells; that is ZLE waiting on the ^X prefix, not a divergence.

observed_when_diverging.recorded_under: 2026-10-28, a copy of target/debug/zshrs built from the shared tree at ab5f51192e before the fix (zshrs 0.13.56, 133989832 bytes, sha256_16 7a44909f4100757b)

origin: lane-9 widget-axis sweep (2026-10-28): stock compinit binds ^Xn to `_next_tags`; found by driving every compinit widget binding by hand, since compsys_spec_fuzz's widget pool and key names have no `_next_tags` / `cx-n` entry

guard_verified.against: the pre-fix binary named in observed_when_diverging.recorded_under
